name: io.github.tonyyang0504/workable-mcp
description: Workable (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WORKABLE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Workable API access token (Settings > Integrations > Apps / API access token) with the r_jobs scope; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It is the employer account's token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WORKABLE_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: The Workable account subdomain, e.g. 'groove-tech' in https://groove-tech.workable.com.
